Contract locking by Invoiced period

While creating new version/editing contract version of the contract, search for invoices for this contract and identify max date according invoice billing data and restrict creating/editing contract version before and on this date.

  • System locking: for this contract should be checked all billing run meter reading period to date which is connected to this contract with status: in progress/paused/.. (until billing run is completed/cancelled) - and after this billing run meter reading period to date should allow new version creation/current version editing

 

Specific permissions to allow editing locked object

  • With Edit lock permission:

    • all values will be editable except POD activation/deactivation dates / contract version start date before meter reading period to date

    • new version of contract creation is possible before max invoiced date but POD configuration should be exactly the same which was in previous version of contract (in the version which we are splitting);

    • Should be checked on POD version level to be exactly the same configuration before max date

 

 

New Automatic processes to set /remove PODs in future version with defined rules

Rules for adding/removing POD and new contract versions after max invoiced date

 

Note: This rules should be checked on POD level, not POD version level

If contract new version is created in the middle and POD is added in previous version and isn't added in middle - remove it from all future versions even if it is activated in the future for this contract

  • If pod was activated in previous version and deactivation date was more than middle version start date Set deactivation date in previous version as a middle version start date - 1 day and Set deactivation reason new hardcode value  ='Additional agreement for POD removing'

 

If contract new version is created in the middle and POD is added in previous version and is added in middle - don't change anything in future versions

  • If pod was activated in previous version and deactivation date was more than middle version start date

    • Set deactivation date in previous version as a middle version start date - 1 day and Set deactivation reason ='new version is activated' 

    • In middle version set POD activation = middle version start date and POD  deactivation dates = deactivation date from previous version

If In the middle version new POD is added which isn't in the future version it should also be added in future versions

If in the middle new pod is added which was in the previous/future version -  do nothing

If in the middle version POD is not added and is added In future version and doesn't exist in previous version - do nothing

When manually adding or removing a Point of Delivery (POD) in the current version, a popup should be displayed. This popup should include:

(This pop-up should not be displayed during product contract creation)

In manual current version editing POD is added - firstly to show confirmation message and if confirms add in all future versions

  • If user doesn't confirm message to add only In current version without adding in future versions

  • Message is manageable from system messages

In manual current version editing POD is removed - and this pod is added in future versions firstly to show confirmation message and if confirms remove from all future versions

  • If user doesn't confirm message to remove only In current version without removing in future versions ;

  • Message is manageable from system messages

Save button

Upon clicking the Save button, the selected POD(s) will be added or removed in all future versions.

Cancel

If the Cancel button is clicked, no changes will be applied, and the POD(s) will not be added or removed in the next version.

  1. For product contract and for service contract version status Signed (ÐÐ¾Ð´Ð¿Ð¸ÑÐ°Ð½ Ð¾Ñ Ð´Ð²ÐµÑÐµ ÑÑÑÐ°Ð½Ð¸) should be changed to Valid/Signed by both sides (ÐÐ°Ð»Ð¸Ð´ÐµÐ½/ ÐÐ¾Ð´Ð¿Ð¸ÑÐ°Ð½ Ð¾Ñ Ð´Ð²ÐµÑÐµ ÑÑÑÐ°Ð½Ð¸)

 

Change - first version should be Valid

  1. The first version of the contract should be by default Valid and it should be not editable (Only in product contract).

    1. Manual creation

    2. Mass Import

    3. Express contract - should be created always as Valid

New permission to Create only additional agreements

Change - product contract editing with new permission

  1. In the system should be added new Permission which will allow to correct limited fields:

    1. Permission - Contract Edit Additional agreements

  2. A system user with this permission can only create a new version of an existing contract (Product contract)

    1. “Updating current version” button should be disabled

  3. All contracts can be used to create new version with this permission:

    1. in all contract statuses - Draft, ready, signed, enter into force, active in terms, active in perpetuity, terminated, cancelled

    2. Locked contracts can be also edited with this permission after max date

  4. The user with this permission can edit following fields:

  5. Basic parameters Tab

    1. 'Contract Version Status' is automatically set to 'Ready' based on permissions and cannot be changed."

    2. 'Type' is set to 'Additional Agreement' and should be disabled."

    3. All other fields in the 'Basic Parameters' tab should be disabled

    4. The sub objects Customer and Related contracts/orders cannot be edited

    5. The sub objects Communication data for billing, Communication data for contract and Proxy can be edited

    6. The sub objects Contract files and Additional documents adding files is allowed but removing the existing ones is not allowed

      1. already saved files can’t be deleted, but files which are uploaded while this editing process can be removed

  6. Additional parameters Tab

    1. All fields and sub-objects in the 'Additional parameters' tab should be enabled except Direct debit checkbox, Applicable interest rate drop-down, Bank, BIC and IBAN (these fields should be disabled).

  7. Product parameters in these tabs

    1. All fields and sub-objects must be disabled.

  8. Point of delivery tab

    1. Should be enabled following buttons:

      1. Add all points of delivery

      2. Add active points of delivery

      3. Import points of delivery

      4. Add points of delivery (choose billing group Inside Pop up)

      5. Checkboxes for selecting PODs and “Remove” button should be enabled.

    2. All below buttons/fields should not be enabled

      1. “Adding new billing group”

      2. “Deleting billing group”

      3. “Move selected to Billing Group”

      4. “Action”

      5. Deal number

Create new version

Clicking on Create new version Will check all validations in frontend. If successful will display pop-up to add draft version start date.

Ready start date = start date of the first version of contract with statuses Draft, Ready and Cancelled.

  1. It is required start date to be unique for all of versions of a contract (doesn’t matter this version is valid or not). One contract cannot have more than one version active in one day.

    1. two draft versions shouldn’t exist with same start date

    2. If user selects start date which is already added, will display error message

  2. it is possible to create draft version with an old /future dates. Draft version start date must be more than the first version start date

  3. Draft Version start date should be saved separately as a “Draft Start Date” but leaves the end date undefined until it is activated (i.e., when its status changes to “Valid / Signed by both sides”).

    1. Contract versions should be always continued without any overlapping or gaps only considering valid version status (draft start/end dates will be ignored in system before this draft version isn’t changed to Valid / Signed by both sides)

    2. Skipping Invalid Versions: The system will skip processing any contract version which is not valid

  4. After creating new version system automatically should do following:

    1. Clear POD activation and deactivation dates in newly created draft version of contract.

    2. in valid old /future versions shouldn’t be cleared/or modified POD activation and deactivation dates

    3. if in newly created draft version new POD is added system shouldn’t add this POD in all future versions (valid, not valid)

    4. if in newly created draft version POD is removed system shouldn’t remove this POD in all future versions (valid, not valid)

    5. Note: if contract version is created directly with valid status should add and and remove PODs automatically as it works now

  5. All versions in the dropdown should be displayed with their status: Valid / Not Valid.

  6. Not Valid versions should not have an end date.

  7. Not Valid versions should appear last in the list.

  8. Format:

    1. 1 / (04.02.2025 - 04.02.2025) Valid

    2. 2 / (05.02.2025 - Open end) Valid

    3. 3/ (06.10.2025) Not valid

Rules for making version Valid

Change - edit current version of contract

In product contract current version editing should be checked if contract version status was changed from not valid to → valid

Flow 1 - > when a contract version’s status changes from draft, cancelled, ready to “Valid/Signed by both sides.” Here’s how it will work

  1. Previous contract version

  2. Set version end date as (draft start date minus [-] 1 day)

  3. Current contract version

  4. Version start date = draft start date

  5. Version end date should become next valid version start date minus [-] 1 day, if such exists. If there is no future version, the new one should not have end date (open end).

All processes in system to consider only valid versions

Change 4 - consider in processes valid status

  1. When version status is Canceled, Ready or Draft this version should be ignored by all Processes.

  2. When version status is “Valid / Signed” this version should be used
